facts.fact: The Council of Ministers of 1 June 2022 adopted a draft decree approving the contract for the Projet d'Accès au service de télécommunication des collectivités territoriales, awarded to SIMO TELECOM for CFA 9,407,295,000 all taxes included over twelve months; its communiqué says the project is to put telecommunication infrastructure in place at the level of the collectivités territoriales and give the Administration its own secure, autonomous network.
facts.system: Projet d'Accès au service de télécommunication des collectivités territoriales

facts.fact: The communiqué of the Council of Ministers of 1 June 2022 states that the Projet d'Accès au service de télécommunication des collectivités territoriales, a contract of CFA 9,407,295,000, is entirely financed by the Agence de Gestion du Fonds d'Accès Universel.

systems.owner: the State; financed by the Agence de Gestion du Fonds d'Accès Universel (AGEFAU)
systems.tiers: telecommunication infrastructure 'at the level of the different collectivités territoriales'; the Administration's own network; no office said to be connected

note: A contract approved, not a connection made: no collectivité is said to be connected. The communiqué's words leave open whether the network serves the collectivités' own offices or the State administration in their areas; the class is read from the project's name and the parent may reclass it central.
